## 🚀 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

## 💡 Motivation / Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe. 
*(e.g., "I want to display Spotify now-playing cards on my bio page...")*

## 🎨 Proposed Solution / Design Concept

Describe the solution you'd like to see. 
- How should it work in `config.js`?
- How should it look on `index.html`?
- Is it configurable in the visual builder (`edit.html`)?

## 🖼️ Mockups or Examples

If you have design mockups, wireframes, or reference examples from other sites, attach them here.

## ➕ Additional Context

Add any other context, technical considerations, or ideas about the feature request here.
